record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.context_brief: analytic versus algebraic structure on exotic affine spaces
record.original_question: Do there exist exotic affine spaces X that are diffeomorphic but not isomorphic to C^n such that two such exotic C^n's are biholomorphic but not algebraically isomorphic, or such that there is a nontrivial deformation family of exotic C^n's with the same underlying analytic structure?

evidence.quote: QUESTION. Does there exist a pair of exotic Cn’s which are biholomorphic but not isomorphic ? Does there exist a non-trivial deformation family of exotic Cn’s with the same underlying analytic structure ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Call a smooth complex affine algebraic variety $X$ of dimension $n$ an exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$ if $X$ is diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ but not algebraically isomorphic to the affine space $\mathbb{C}^n$. 

(a) Do there exist two exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$'s $X$ and $Y$ that are biholomorphic as complex analytic varieties but not isomorphic as algebraic varieties?

(b) Does there exist a nontrivial algebraic deformation family $\{X_t\}_{t\in T}$ of exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$'s (a smooth morphism $\mathcal{X}\to T$ with positive-dimensional base $T$ whose fibers are exotic $\mathbb{C}^n$'s) such that all fibers $X_t$ share the same underlying complex analytic structure (i.e., are pairwise biholomorphic) while not all being algebraically isomorphic?
artifact.status_search_result: Part (a) has been answered affirmatively in dimension 3: Dubouloz constructed pairs of non-isomorphic contractible affine threefolds (with isomorphic cylinders) that are biholomorphic as complex analytic varieties, giving examples of biholomorphic but non-algebraically-isomorphic exotic affine 3-spaces. Subsequent work by Dubouloz–Fasel produced positive-dimensional families of pairwise non-isomorphic $\mathbb{A}^1$-contractible affine threefolds. The full question (existence in all dimensions and for the strict diffeomorphism-to-$\mathbb{C}^n$ class, plus the deformation-family form) does not appear to be definitively settled in the general form posed.

status_evidence.title: On exotic affine 3-spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Dubouloz constructs non-isomorphic contractible affine threefolds that are biholomorphic as complex analytic varieties.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of biholomorphic but non-isomorphic exotic affine threefolds is established.

status_evidence.title: Families of A^1-contractible affine threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Dubouloz and Fasel provide families of pairwise non-isomorphic affine threefolds that are A^1-contractible.
status_evidence.claim: Nontrivial families of pairwise non-isomorphic exotic-type affine threefolds exist.
